India script 3-2 comeback win over USA in FIH Hockey Women’s Nations Cup opener
IThe Indian Women's Hockey Team staged a remarkable comeback from two goals down to defeat the United States 3-2 in their opening Pool A match of the FIH Hockey Women's Nations Cup on June 15 at the North Harbour National Hockey Centre in Auckland, New Zealand. For India, Deepika netted a brace and Navneet Kaur scored the winning goal, while Ashley Sessa and Madeleine Zimmer were on the scoresheet for the USA.
